sentences.text:
Petitioner is the owner of a truck bearing registration no. JH-12-K-3151, which was seized by Nawabazar police loaded with 850 CFT of stone chips.
It was submitted that the vehicle of the petitioner is a commercial vehicle and the same was in full control of the driver of the vehicle.
It was further submitted that the driver of the vehicle without the knowledge and consent of the petitioner was transporting the seized stone chips.
It was finally submitted that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and this fact has been mentioned at paragraph 12 of the anticipatory bail application.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstances of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.
